import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Resultant.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Mul
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Prod
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.FiniteDimension

/-! Actual bounded polynomials, endowed with their coefficient norm.
No polynomial, derivative or determinant identity is assumed. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev Coeff (n : ℕ) := Polynomial.degreeLT ℝ n

instance coeffNormedAddCommGroup (n : ℕ) : NormedAddCommGroup (Coeff n) :=
  NormedAddCommGroup.induced _ (Fin n → ℝ) (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n)
    (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective

instance coeffNormedSpace (n : ℕ) : NormedSpace ℝ (Coeff n) :=
  NormedSpace.induced ℝ _ (Fin n → ℝ) (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n)

/-- Retain exactly the coefficients of orders less than `n`. -/
def cut (n : ℕ) : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff n :=
  (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    (LinearMap.pi fun i : Fin n => Polynomial.lcoeff ℝ i)

@[simp] theorem degreeLTEquiv_coeff {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) (i : Fin n) :
    degreeLTEquiv ℝ n p i = (p : ℝ[X]).coeff i := rfl

@[simp] theorem cut_coeff (n : ℕ) (p : ℝ[X]) (i : Fin n) :
    ((cut n p : Coeff n) : ℝ[X]).coeff i = p.coeff i := by
  exact congrFun ((degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).apply_symm_apply (fun j : Fin n => p.coeff j)) i

@[simp] theorem cut_coe {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : cut n (p : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective
  funext i
  simp

/-- Coefficient truncation of the actual polynomial product, as a bilinear map. -/
def mulLM (m n r : ℕ) : Coeff m →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff n →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff r :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ (fun p q => cut r ((p : ℝ[X]) * (q : ℝ[X])))
    (by intros; simp [add_mul])
    (by intros; simp [smul_mul_assoc])
    (by intros; simp [mul_add])
    (by intros; simp [mul_smul_comm])

def mulCLM (m n r : ℕ) : Coeff m →L[ℝ] Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff r :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
    ((LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap :
      (Coeff n →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff r) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff r)).toLinearMap.comp
      (mulLM m n r))

@[simp] theorem mulCLM_apply {m n r : ℕ} (p : Coeff m) (q : Coeff n) :
    mulCLM m n r p q = cut r ((p : ℝ[X]) * (q : ℝ[X])) := rfl

/-- The linear inclusion of a polynomial of degree `< n` into degree `< n+1`. -/
def liftLM (n : ℕ) : Coeff n →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  (cut (n+1)).comp (degreeLT ℝ n).subtype

def liftCLM (n : ℕ) : Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (liftLM n)

lemma coeff_eq_zero_of_bound {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) {k : ℕ} (hk : n ≤ k) :
    (p : ℝ[X]).coeff k = 0 := by
  exact Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
    ((Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mp p.property).trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hk))

@[simp] theorem coe_lift {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (liftCLM n p : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  ext k
  by_cases hk : k < n+1
  · exact cut_coeff (n+1) (p : ℝ[X]) ⟨k,hk⟩
  · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ (Nat.le_of_not_gt hk),
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p (by omega)]

def topMonomial (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) :=
  ⟨X^n, Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mpr (by
    rw [Polynomial.degree_X_pow]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n)⟩

def monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : Coeff (n+1) :=
  topMonomial n + liftCLM n p

@[simp] theorem coe_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]) = X^n + (p : ℝ[X]) := by
  simp [monicPoly, topMonomial]

lemma bounded_natDegree {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    (p : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ n := by
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr
  intro k hk
  exact coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p (by omega)

/-- The affine monic-coordinate map has the actual Frechet derivative equal
    to its coefficient inclusion, including the degree-zero case. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    HasFDerivAt monicPoly (liftCLM n) p := by
  exact (liftCLM n).hasFDerivAt.const_add (topMonomial n)

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.Coefficients

noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree
open Module

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

/-- The derivative block occurring in polynomial numerator/denominator gluing. -/
def repeatedBlock (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) : (E × E) →L[ℝ] (F × F) :=
  (L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E E)).prod
    (C.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E E) +
      L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E E))

@[simp] theorem repeatedBlock_apply (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × E) :
    repeatedBlock L C x = (L x.1, C x.1 + L x.2) := rfl

lemma toMatrix_repeatedBlock {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F) (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bE) (bF.prod bF) (repeatedBlock L C).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap) 0
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF C.toLinearMap)
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, repeatedBlock]

/-- An exact determinant theorem: no nonsingularity assumptions on either block. -/
theorem det_repeatedBlock {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F) (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bE) (bF.prod bF)
      (repeatedBlock L C).toLinearMap).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap).det ^ 2 := by
  rw [toMatrix_repeatedBlock, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂, pow_two]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.BlockJacobian

/-! Actual polynomial coefficient gluing and its actual Frechet derivative. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev PolyPair (m n : ℕ) := Coeff m × Coeff n
abbrev GlueInput (m n : ℕ) := PolyPair m n × PolyPair m n

def pairBasis (m n : ℕ) : Module.Basis (Fin (m+n)) ℝ (PolyPair m n) :=
  ((degreeLT.basis ℝ m).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)).reindex finSumFinEquiv

lemma coeff_natDegree_le {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : (p : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ n := by
  simpa using bounded_natDegree (liftCLM n p)

def sylvCLM {m n : ℕ} (f g : ℝ[X]) (hf : f.natDegree ≤ m) (hg : g.natDegree ≤ n) :
    PolyPair m n →L[ℝ] Coeff (m+n) :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (sylvesterMap f g hf hg)

@[simp] theorem sylvCLM_cut {m n : ℕ} (f g : ℝ[X])
    (hf : f.natDegree ≤ m) (hg : g.natDegree ≤ n) (x : PolyPair m n) :
    sylvCLM f g hf hg x = cut (m+n) (f * (x.2 : ℝ[X]) + g * (x.1 : ℝ[X])) := by
  exact (cut_coe (sylvesterMap f g hf hg x)).symm

def monoSylv {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) : PolyPair m n →L[ℝ] Coeff (m+n) :=
  sylvCLM (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly x.2)
    (bounded_natDegree _) (bounded_natDegree _)

def lowSylv {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) : PolyPair m n →L[ℝ] Coeff (m+n) :=
  sylvCLM x.1 x.2 (coeff_natDegree_le _) (coeff_natDegree_le _)

/-- The non-leading coefficients of `U*V`, and all coefficients of `R*V+U*S`.
Here U and V are actual monic polynomials with the supplied low coefficients;
R and S have arbitrary coefficients of degrees below m and n. -/
def glue {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) : Coeff (m+n) × Coeff (m+n) :=
  (mulCLM (m+1) (n+1) (m+n) (monicPoly x.1.1) (monicPoly x.1.2),
   mulCLM m (n+1) (m+n) x.2.1 (monicPoly x.1.2) +
     mulCLM (m+1) n (m+n) (monicPoly x.1.1) x.2.2)

/-- The complete derivative, including the off-diagonal numerator terms. -/
def glueDerivative {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) :
    GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] (Coeff (m+n) × Coeff (m+n)) :=
  repeatedBlock (monoSylv x.1) (lowSylv x.2)

set_option maxHeartbeats 600000 in
theorem hasFDerivAt_glue {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) :
    HasFDerivAt glue (glueDerivative x) x := by
  let A : GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] Coeff m :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (PolyPair m n) (PolyPair m n))
  let B : GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] Coeff n :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (PolyPair m n) (PolyPair m n))
  let R : GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] Coeff m :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (PolyPair m n) (PolyPair m n))
  let S : GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] Coeff n :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (PolyPair m n) (PolyPair m n))
  have ha := (hasFDerivAt_monicPoly (A x)).comp x A.hasFDerivAt
  have hb := (hasFDerivAt_monicPoly (B x)).comp x B.hasFDerivAt
  have hp := ((mulCLM (m+1) (n+1) (m+n)).hasFDerivAt.comp x ha).clm_apply hb
  have hr := ((mulCLM m (n+1) (m+n)).hasFDerivAt.comp x R.hasFDerivAt).clm_apply hb
  have hs := ((mulCLM (m+1) n (m+n)).hasFDerivAt.comp x ha).clm_apply S.hasFDerivAt
  apply (hp.prodMk (hr.add hs)).congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro h
  apply Prod.ext
  all_goals
    simp only [glueDerivative, repeatedBlock_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply,
      Function.comp_apply, A, B, R, S,
      monoSylv, lowSylv, sylvCLM_cut,
      mulCLM_apply, coe_lift]
  · change cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.2 : ℝ[X])) +
        cut (m+n) ((h.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (monicPoly x.1.2 : ℝ[X])) =
      cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.2 : ℝ[X]) +
        (monicPoly x.1.2 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.1 : ℝ[X]))
    rw [map_add, mul_comm (h.1.1 : ℝ[X])]
  · change (cut (m+n) ((x.2.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.2 : ℝ[X])) +
        cut (m+n) ((h.2.1 : ℝ[X]) * (monicPoly x.1.2 : ℝ[X]))) +
      (cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.2.2 : ℝ[X])) +
        cut (m+n) ((h.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (x.2.2 : ℝ[X]))) =
      cut (m+n) ((x.2.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.2 : ℝ[X]) +
        (x.2.2 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.1 : ℝ[X])) +
      cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.2.2 : ℝ[X]) +
        (monicPoly x.1.2 : ℝ[X]) * (h.2.1 : ℝ[X]))
    simp only [map_add]
    rw [mul_comm (h.2.1 : ℝ[X]), mul_comm (h.1.1 : ℝ[X])]
    abel

/-- The Jacobian of the actual real coefficient map, in specified coefficient bases. -/
def gluingJacobian {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((pairBasis m n).prod (pairBasis m n))
    ((degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n)).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n)))
    (fderiv ℝ glue x).toLinearMap).det

/-- The two-polynomial gluing formula for every degree, every numerator and
all coefficients. Common roots and zero resultant are included. -/
theorem gluingJacobian_eq_resultant_sq {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) :
    gluingJacobian x =
      Polynomial.resultant (monicPoly x.1.1) (monicPoly x.1.2) m n ^ 2 := by
  rw [gluingJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_glue x).fderiv]
  change (LinearMap.toMatrix _ _ (repeatedBlock _ _).toLinearMap).det = _
  rw [det_repeatedBlock]
  change (LinearMap.toMatrix (pairBasis m n) (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n))
    (sylvesterMap (monicPoly x.1.1) (monicPoly x.1.2)
      (bounded_natDegree _) (bounded_natDegree _))).det ^ 2 = _
  rw [pairBasis, Polynomial.toMatrix_sylvesterMap']
  rfl

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.Coefficients

/-! Leading-coefficient charts for the actual bounded polynomial spaces. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma monic_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]).Monic := by
  rw [coe_monicPoly]
  exact Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add (Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mp p.property)

@[simp] lemma monicPoly_coeff_top {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]).coeff n = 1 := by
  simp [coe_monicPoly, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p le_rfl]

@[simp] lemma natDegree_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]).natDegree = n := by
  apply le_antisymm (bounded_natDegree _)
  exact Polynomial.le_natDegree_of_ne_zero (by
    rw [monicPoly_coeff_top]
    exact one_ne_zero)

lemma cut_X_pow_of_le (n k : ℕ) (hnk : n ≤ k) : cut n (X^k) = 0 := by
  apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective
  funext i
  change ((cut n (X^k) : Coeff n) : ℝ[X]).coeff i = 0
  rw [cut_coeff]
  simp [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, show (i : ℕ) ≠ k from by omega]

/-- Assemble a leading coefficient and all lower coefficients, without division. -/
def joinLeadingLM (n : ℕ) : (ℝ × Coeff n) →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) where
  toFun x := x.1 • topMonomial n + liftCLM n x.2
  map_add' x y := by simp [add_smul]; abel
  map_smul' c x := by simp [smul_add, smul_smul]

@[simp] lemma coe_joinLeadingLM {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    (joinLeadingLM n x : ℝ[X]) = x.1 • (X^n : ℝ[X]) + (x.2 : ℝ[X]) := by
  simp [joinLeadingLM, topMonomial]

/-- Split a bounded polynomial into its leading coefficient and its truncation. -/
def splitLeadingLM (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) →ₗ[ℝ] (ℝ × Coeff n) :=
  ((Polynomial.lcoeff ℝ n).comp (degreeLT ℝ (n+1)).subtype).prod
    ((cut n).comp (degreeLT ℝ (n+1)).subtype)

@[simp] lemma splitLeadingLM_apply {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    splitLeadingLM n p = ((p : ℝ[X]).coeff n, cut n (p : ℝ[X])) := rfl

lemma split_joinLeading {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    splitLeadingLM n (joinLeadingLM n x) = x := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp [coe_joinLeadingLM, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound x.2 le_rfl]
  · simp [coe_joinLeadingLM, cut_X_pow_of_le n n le_rfl]

lemma join_splitLeading {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    joinLeadingLM n (splitLeadingLM n p) = p := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_joinLeadingLM]
  ext k
  simp only [splitLeadingLM_apply, Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_smul,
    smul_eq_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
  rcases lt_trichotomy k n with h | h | h
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_lt h), mul_zero, zero_add]
    exact cut_coeff n (p : ℝ[X]) ⟨k,h⟩
  · subst k
    rw [if_pos rfl, mul_one, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ le_rfl, add_zero]
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_gt h), mul_zero,
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ h.le, zero_add,
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p (by omega)]

/-- The exact linear isomorphism between high-first and ordinary polynomial coefficients. -/
def leadingEquiv (n : ℕ) : (ℝ × Coeff n) ≃ₗ[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  { joinLeadingLM n with
    invFun := splitLeadingLM n
    left_inv := split_joinLeading
    right_inv := join_splitLeading }

@[simp] lemma leadingEquiv_apply {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    leadingEquiv n x = joinLeadingLM n x := rfl

@[simp] lemma leadingEquiv_symm_apply {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    (leadingEquiv n).symm p = splitLeadingLM n p := rfl

lemma monicPoly_eq_leadingEquiv {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    monicPoly p = leadingEquiv n (1,p) := by
  simp [monicPoly, leadingEquiv, joinLeadingLM]

/-- Leading degree first, then increasing lower degrees. -/
def leadingBasis (n : ℕ) : Basis (Unit ⊕ Fin n) ℝ (Coeff (n+1)) :=
  ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)).map (leadingEquiv n)

/-- Truncation is exact whenever the original polynomial already satisfies the bound. -/
lemma coe_cut_of_degree_lt {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.degree < n) :
    (cut n p : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  let q : Coeff n := ⟨p, Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mpr hp⟩
  exact congrArg (fun z : Coeff n => (z : ℝ[X])) (cut_coe q)

/-- Actual monic polynomials are recovered from their non-leading coefficients. -/
lemma monic_reconstruct {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.Monic) (hd : p.natDegree = n) :
    (monicPoly (cut n p) : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  ext k
  rw [coe_monicPoly, Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
  rcases lt_trichotomy k n with hk | hk | hk
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_lt hk), zero_add]
    exact cut_coeff n p ⟨k,hk⟩
  · subst k
    rw [if_pos rfl, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ le_rfl, add_zero]
    rw [← hd, Polynomial.coeff_natDegree, hp]
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_gt hk), zero_add,
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ hk.le,
      Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.LeadingCoefficients
import HydrologyTree.BlockJacobian

/-! The monic-numerator scaling factor, including zero scale and degree zero. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

section Generic
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

def scaleChart (x : ℝ × E) : ℝ × E := (x.1, x.1 • x.2)

def scaleChartDerivative (x : ℝ × E) : (ℝ × E) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × E) :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).prod
    (x.1 • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E +
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).smulRight x.2)

/-- The actual derivative of multiplication of the lower coefficients by the scale. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_scaleChart (x : ℝ × E) :
    HasFDerivAt scaleChart (scaleChartDerivative x) x := by
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).hasFDerivAt.prodMk
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).hasFDerivAt.smul
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E).hasFDerivAt)

lemma toMatrix_scaleChartDerivative {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι ℝ E) (x : ℝ × E) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b)
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b) (scaleChartDerivative x).toLinearMap =
    Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ) 0
      (Matrix.of fun i (_ : Unit) => b.repr x.2 i) (x.1 • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, scaleChartDerivative, Matrix.one_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

/-- An all-dimensional, all-scale determinant identity, not a generic-rank statement. -/
theorem det_scaleChartDerivative {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι ℝ E) (x : ℝ × E) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b)
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b) (scaleChartDerivative x).toLinearMap).det =
      x.1 ^ Fintype.card ι := by
  rw [toMatrix_scaleChartDerivative, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂]
  simp [Matrix.det_smul]

end Generic

/-- Multiplication of an actual monic polynomial by its unrestricted scalar. -/
def scaleMonic {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) : Coeff (n+1) := x.1 • monicPoly x.2

lemma scaleMonic_eq_comp {n : ℕ} :
    scaleMonic (n := n) = (leadingEquiv n) ∘ scaleChart := by
  funext x
  rw [scaleMonic, monicPoly_eq_leadingEquiv]
  symm
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, scaleChart, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using
    (leadingEquiv n).map_smul x.1 (1,x.2)

def scaleMonicDerivative {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    (ℝ × Coeff n) →L[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=

/-! The actual coefficient transformation P=(X+d)F-N at a rooted compartment. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

section Generic
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

def rootChart (C : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E →L[ℝ] E) (x : E × (ℝ × E)) : E × (ℝ × E) :=
  (x.1, (x.2.1 + C x.1, D x.1 + x.2.1 • x.1 - x.2.2))

def rootFiber (f : E) : (ℝ × E) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × E) :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).prod
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).smulRight f - ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E)

@[simp] lemma rootFiber_apply (f : E) (h : ℝ × E) :
    rootFiber f h = (h.1, h.1 • f - h.2) := rfl

def rootChartDerivative (C : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E →L[ℝ] E) (x : E × (ℝ × E)) :
    (E × (ℝ × E)) →L[ℝ] (E × (ℝ × E)) :=
  lowerBlock (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)
    (C.prod (D + x.2.1 • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)) (rootFiber x.1)

/-- This is the Frechet derivative of the actual root coefficient operation. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_rootChart (C : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E →L[ℝ] E) (x : E × (ℝ × E)) :
    HasFDerivAt (rootChart C D) (rootChartDerivative C D x) x := by
  let F : (E × (ℝ × E)) →L[ℝ] E := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E (ℝ × E)
  let B : (E × (ℝ × E)) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E (ℝ × E))
  let N : (E × (ℝ × E)) →L[ℝ] E :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E (ℝ × E))
  have hb := B.hasFDerivAt.add (C.hasFDerivAt.comp x F.hasFDerivAt)
  have hn := ((D.hasFDerivAt.comp x F.hasFDerivAt).add
    (B.hasFDerivAt.smul F.hasFDerivAt)).sub N.hasFDerivAt
  apply (F.hasFDerivAt.prodMk (hb.prodMk hn)).congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro h
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · apply Prod.ext
    · change h.2.1 + C h.1 = C h.1 + h.2.1
      abel
    · change D h.1 + (x.2.1 • h.1 + h.2.1 • x.1) - h.2.2 =
        (D h.1 + x.2.1 • h.1) + (h.2.1 • x.1 - h.2.2)
      abel

    (b : Basis ι ℝ E) (f : E) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b)
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b) (rootFiber f).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ) 0
        (Matrix.of fun i (_ : Unit) => b.repr f i) (-1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, rootFiber, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

theorem det_rootFiber {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι ℝ E) (f : E) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b)
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b) (rootFiber f).toLinearMap).det =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι := by
  rw [toMatrix_rootFiber, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂]
  simp [Matrix.det_neg]

/-- The root operation is a polynomial coordinate change with determinant ±1
at every coefficient vector, not just away from a discriminant or zero rates. -/
theorem det_rootChartDerivative {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι ℝ E) (C : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E →L[ℝ] E) (x : E × (ℝ × E)) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (b.prod ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b))
      (b.prod ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b))
      (rootChartDerivative C D x).toLinearMap).det = (-1 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι := by
  rw [rootChartDerivative, det_lowerBlock, det_rootFiber]
  simp

end Generic

/-- Coefficient crossing the truncation boundary when a polynomial is multiplied by X. -/
def shiftTop (n : ℕ) : Coeff n →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
    (((Polynomial.lcoeff ℝ n).comp (LinearMap.mulLeft ℝ (X : ℝ[X]))).comp (degreeLT ℝ n).subtype)

/-- Lower coefficients of the actual polynomial X*f. -/
def shiftLow (n : ℕ) : Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff n :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
    (((cut n).comp (LinearMap.mulLeft ℝ (X : ℝ[X]))).comp (degreeLT ℝ n).subtype)

/-- Physical Schur-complement root polynomial, before any response cancellation. -/
def rootPolynomial {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) : ℝ[X] :=
  (X + C x.2.1) * (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X]) - (x.2.2 : ℝ[X])

lemma rootPolynomial_cut {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    cut n (rootPolynomial x) = shiftLow n x.1 + x.2.1 • x.1 - x.2.2 := by
  simp only [rootPolynomial, coe_monicPoly, add_mul, mul_add, map_sub, map_add]
  rw [show (X : ℝ[X]) * X^n = X^(n+1) by rw [pow_succ'],
    cut_X_pow_of_le n (n+1) (by omega)]
  rw [← smul_eq_C_mul, map_smul, cut_X_pow_of_le n n le_rfl, smul_zero]
  rw [← smul_eq_C_mul, map_smul, cut_coe, cut_coe]
  change 0 + 0 + (shiftLow n x.1 + x.2.1 • x.1) - x.2.2 = _
  abel

    (rootPolynomial x).coeff n = x.2.1 + shiftTop n x.1 := by
  simp only [rootPolynomial, coe_monicPoly, add_mul, mul_add,
    Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_add]
  rw [show (X : ℝ[X]) * X^n = X^(n+1) by rw [pow_succ']]
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul,
    coeff_eq_zero_of_bound x.1 le_rfl, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound x.2.2 le_rfl,
    if_pos rfl, if_neg (show n ≠ n+1 from by omega), mul_one, mul_zero,
    sub_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
  simp only [ite_true, mul_one]
  rfl

/-- The actual (unreduced) root polynomial coefficient chart. -/
def rootCoefficientMap {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n) :=
  (x.1, ((rootPolynomial x).coeff n, cut n (rootPolynomial x)))

lemma rootCoefficientMap_eq {n : ℕ} :
    rootCoefficientMap (n := n) = rootChart (shiftTop n) (shiftLow n) := by
  funext x
  simp [rootCoefficientMap, rootChart, rootPolynomial_cut, rootPolynomial_coeff_next]

theorem hasFDerivAt_rootCoefficientMap {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    HasFDerivAt rootCoefficientMap (rootChartDerivative (shiftTop n) (shiftLow n) x) x := by
  rw [rootCoefficientMap_eq]
  exact hasFDerivAt_rootChart _ _ _

def rootCoefficientJacobian {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix
    ((degreeLT.basis ℝ n).prod ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)))
    ((degreeLT.basis ℝ n).prod ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)))
    (fderiv ℝ rootCoefficientMap x).toLinearMap).det

/-- The true polynomial coefficient-map derivative has determinant (-1)^n,
without assuming invertibility, positivity, or absence of common roots. -/
theorem rootCoefficientJacobian_eq {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    rootCoefficientJacobian x = (-1 : ℝ)^n := by
  rw [rootCoefficientJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_rootCoefficientMap x).fderiv,
    det_rootChartDerivative]
  simp

lemma degree_rootProduct {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    ((X + C x.2.1) * (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X])).degree = ((n+1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
  rw [Polynomial.degree_mul, Polynomial.degree_X_add_C,
    Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicPoly x.1).ne_zero,
    natDegree_monicPoly]
  simp [Nat.cast_add, add_comm]

lemma rootNumerator_degree_lt {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    (x.2.2 : ℝ[X]).degree < ((X + C x.2.1) * (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X])).degree := by
  rw [degree_rootProduct]
  exact (Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mp x.2.2.property).trans_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ n)

/-- The root update never drops degree, including zero edge rates. -/
theorem rootPolynomial_monic {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    (rootPolynomial x).Monic := by
  exact ((Polynomial.monic_X_add_C x.2.1).mul (monic_monicPoly x.1)).sub_of_left
    (rootNumerator_degree_lt x)

theorem rootPolynomial_natDegree {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    (rootPolynomial x).natDegree = n+1 := by
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some
  rw [rootPolynomial, Polynomial.degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt (rootNumerator_degree_lt x),
    degree_rootProduct]

/-- The checked coefficient map determines the entire actual root polynomial. -/
theorem rootPolynomial_reconstruct {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    (monicPoly (cut (n+1) (rootPolynomial x)) : ℝ[X]) = rootPolynomial x :=
  monic_reconstruct _ (rootPolynomial_monic x) (rootPolynomial_natDegree x)

end HydrologyTree

/-! Actual conservative tree rate coordinates, with arbitrary finite size.
Vertices are topologically numbered from the designated leak/root 0.
The parameter at 0 is the leak; at every other vertex it is the transfer rate
toward its parent. No positivity or nonzero-rate premise is used below. -/
open Module Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- A finite rooted tree in a topological vertex numbering. Every nonroot
vertex i+1 has exactly one parent, with smaller vertex number. -/
structure OrderedTree (n : ℕ) where
  parent : Fin n → Fin (n+1)
  parent_le : ∀ i, (parent i).val ≤ i.val

abbrev VertexValues (n : ℕ) := Fin (n+1) → ℝ
abbrev EdgeValues (n : ℕ) := Fin n → ℝ
abbrev TreeRates (n : ℕ) := VertexValues n × EdgeValues n

lemma parent_ne_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (i : Fin n) :
    t.parent i ≠ i.succ := by
  intro h
  have hle := t.parent_le i
  have := congrArg Fin.val h
  simp only [Fin.val_succ] at this
  omega

/-- Parent-incidence matrix of the actual labelled tree. -/
def parentIncidence {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin n) ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun v e => if t.parent e = v then 1 else 0

/-- Derivative of c_e=a_e f_e with respect to the inward/diagonal parameters. -/
def childWeighted {n : ℕ} (f : EdgeValues n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun e v => if e.succ = v then f e else 0

def parentCLM {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : EdgeValues n →L[ℝ] VertexValues n :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Matrix.toLin' (parentIncidence t))

@[simp] lemma parentCLM_apply {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (f : EdgeValues n)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) :
    parentCLM t f v = ∑ e, if t.parent e = v then f e else 0 := by
  simp [parentCLM, Matrix.toLin'_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
    parentIncidence, ite_mul]

/-- Physical rate chart: d_v is the sum of all rates leaving v, and c_e is
exactly the product of the two opposed rates on edge e. -/
def rateChart {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : TreeRates n :=
  (x.1 + parentCLM t x.2, fun e => x.1 e.succ * x.2 e)

def rateChartDerivative {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    TreeRates n →L[ℝ] TreeRates n :=
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n)) +
    (parentCLM t).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))).prod
    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun e : Fin n =>
      x.1 e.succ • ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))) +
      x.2 e • ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e.succ).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))))

/-- The rate-coordinate Jacobian is derived from the actual polynomial map. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_rateChart {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    HasFDerivAt (rateChart t) (rateChartDerivative t x) x := by
  apply HasFDerivAt.prodMk
  · exact (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n)).hasFDerivAt.add
      ((parentCLM t).hasFDerivAt.comp x
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n)).hasFDerivAt)
  · apply hasFDerivAt_pi.mpr
    intro e
    exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e.succ).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))).hasFDerivAt.mul
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))).hasFDerivAt

    LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      (rateChartDerivative t x).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks 1 (parentIncidence t) (childWeighted x.2)
        (Matrix.diagonal fun e : Fin n => x.1 e.succ) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, rateChartDerivative, childWeighted,
      parentIncidence, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply,
      Pi.basisFun_apply, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]
  rename_i v j
  symm
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro e _ he
    simp [Ne.symm he]
  · simp

lemma childWeighted_mul_parent {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (f : EdgeValues n)
    (i j : Fin n) :
    (childWeighted f * parentIncidence t) i j = if t.parent j = i.succ then f i else 0 := by
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, childWeighted, parentIncidence, ite_mul, eq_comm]

lemma rateSchur_upperTriangular {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (Matrix.diagonal (fun e : Fin n => x.1 e.succ) -
      childWeighted x.2 * parentIncidence t).IsUpperTriangular := by
  intro i j hij
  have hne : t.parent j ≠ i.succ := by
    intro h
    have hle := t.parent_le j
    have hh := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp only [Fin.val_succ] at hh
    have hijv : j.val < i.val := hij
    omega
  have hneq : i ≠ j := ne_of_gt (show j < i from hij)
  simp [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, childWeighted_mul_parent,
    hne, hneq]

lemma rateSchur_diagonal {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (i : Fin n) :
    (Matrix.diagonal (fun e : Fin n => x.1 e.succ) -
      childWeighted x.2 * parentIncidence t) i i = x.1 i.succ := by
  simp [childWeighted_mul_parent, parent_ne_child]

theorem det_rateChartDerivative {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      (rateChartDerivative t x).toLinearMap).det = ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ := by
  rw [toMatrix_rateChartDerivative, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_one₁₁,
    Matrix.det_of_upperTriangular (rateSchur_upperTriangular t x)]

  exact rateSchur_diagonal t x i

  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
    ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
    (fderiv ℝ (rateChart t) x).toLinearMap).det

theorem physicalRateJacobian_eq {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    physicalRateJacobian t x = ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ := by
  rw [physicalRateJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_rateChart t x).fderiv,
    det_rateChartDerivative]

end HydrologyTree

    (Matrix.single i i (1 : ℝ)) v w = 0 := by
  apply Matrix.single_apply_of_ne

  exact hvw (hi.symm.trans hj)

    (v w : Fin (n+1)) (hvw : v ≠ w) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v w =
      ∑ e : Fin n, (x.1 e.succ * (if t.parent e = v ∧ e.succ = w then 1 else 0) +
        x.2 e * (if e.succ = v ∧ t.parent e = w then 1 else 0)) := by

    Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, single_diagonal_offdiag v w _ hvw,
    mul_zero, sub_zero, Matrix.single_apply]

theorem compartment_inward_entry {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (i : Fin n) :
    compartmentMatrix t x (t.parent i) i.succ = x.1 i.succ := by

  · simp [parent_ne_child t i, Ne.symm (parent_ne_child t i)]
  · intro j _ hji
    have hs : j.succ ≠ i.succ := fun h => hji (Fin.succ_injective _ h)
    simp [hs, no_reversed_tree_edges t i j]
  · simp

/-- The entry away from the parent is exactly its physical outward rate. -/
theorem compartment_outward_entry {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (i : Fin n) :
    compartmentMatrix t x i.succ (t.parent i) = x.2 i := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x _ _ (Ne.symm (parent_ne_child t i)),
    Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp [parent_ne_child t i, Ne.symm (parent_ne_child t i)]
  · intro j _ hji
    have hs : j.succ ≠ i.succ := fun h => hji (Fin.succ_injective _ h)
    have hr : ¬(t.parent j = i.succ ∧ j.succ = t.parent i) := by

    fun i => compartmentMatrix t x (t.parent i) i.succ *
      compartmentMatrix t x i.succ (t.parent i))

  apply Prod.ext
  · funext v
    simp [matrixRateCoordinates, compartment_diagonal]

    HasFDerivAt (matrixRateCoordinates t) (rateChartDerivative t x) x := by
  rw [matrixRateCoordinates_eq]

  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))

  rw [matrixCoordinateJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_matrixRateCoordinates t x).fderiv,

  · intro h

      refine ⟨k+1, ?_⟩
      simpa only [Function.iterate_succ_apply] using hk

    charpoly_add_single_self, diagonalCofactor_add_single_self,
    charpoly_edgeJoin] at h

  linear_combination -h

    (i : ι) (j : κ) (a f : ℝ) :

      diagonalCofactor A i * B.charpoly :=

/-! Actual matrix assembly for an arbitrary finite list of child branches. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

structure MatrixBranch where
  size : ℕ
  matrix : Matrix (Fin (size+1)) (Fin (size+1)) ℝ
  root : Fin (size+1)
  inward : ℝ
  outward : ℝ

def branchP (b : MatrixBranch) : ℝ[X] := b.matrix.charpoly
def branchF (b : MatrixBranch) : ℝ[X] := diagonalCofactor b.matrix b.root
def branchR (b : MatrixBranch) : ℝ[X] := C (b.inward * b.outward) * branchF b

def BranchNodes : List MatrixBranch → Type
  | [] => Unit
  | b :: bs => BranchNodes bs ⊕ Fin (b.size+1)

instance branchNodesFintype : (bs : List MatrixBranch) → Fintype (BranchNodes bs)
  | [] => inferInstanceAs (Fintype Unit)
  | b :: bs => by
    letI := branchNodesFintype bs
    exact inferInstanceAs (Fintype (BranchNodes bs ⊕ Fin (b.size+1)))

instance branchNodesDecidableEq : (bs : List MatrixBranch) → DecidableEq (BranchNodes bs)
  | [] => inferInstanceAs (DecidableEq Unit)
  | b :: bs => by
    letI := branchNodesDecidableEq bs
    exact inferInstanceAs (DecidableEq (BranchNodes bs ⊕ Fin (b.size+1)))

def branchRoot : (bs : List MatrixBranch) → BranchNodes bs
  | [] => ()
  | _ :: bs => Sum.inl (branchRoot bs)

/-- The root diagonal is minus d; every child block retains its original diagonal. -/
def assembledMatrix (d : ℝ) : (bs : List MatrixBranch) →
    Matrix (BranchNodes bs) (BranchNodes bs) ℝ
  | [] => Matrix.of fun _ _ => -d
  | b :: bs => edgeJoin (assembledMatrix d bs) b.matrix (branchRoot bs) b.root b.inward b.outward

def branchProduct (bs : List MatrixBranch) : ℝ[X] := (bs.map branchP).prod

/-- Sum of each branch numerator multiplied by the other denominators. -/
def branchNumerator : List MatrixBranch → ℝ[X]
  | [] => 0
  | b :: bs => branchNumerator bs * branchP b + branchR b * branchProduct bs

@[simp] lemma branchProduct_nil : branchProduct [] = 1 := rfl
@[simp] lemma branchProduct_cons (b : MatrixBranch) (bs : List MatrixBranch) :
    branchProduct (b :: bs) = branchP b * branchProduct bs := by simp [branchProduct]

theorem assembled_cofactor (d : ℝ) (bs : List MatrixBranch) :
    diagonalCofactor (assembledMatrix d bs) (branchRoot bs) = branchProduct bs := by
  induction bs with
  | nil =>
    change ((Matrix.of fun (_ _ : Unit) => -d).charmatrix).adjugate () () = 1
    rw [Matrix.adjugate_subsingleton]
    rfl
  | cons b bs ih =>
    change diagonalCofactor
      (edgeJoin (assembledMatrix d bs) b.matrix (branchRoot bs) b.root b.inward b.outward)
      (Sum.inl (branchRoot bs)) = branchProduct (b::bs)
    rw [diagonalCofactor_edgeJoin_left, ih, branchProduct_cons]
    exact mul_comm _ _

/-- Arbitrary-branch characteristic recursion without spectral restrictions. -/
theorem assembled_characteristic (d : ℝ) (bs : List MatrixBranch) :
    (assembledMatrix d bs).charpoly =
      (X+C d) * branchProduct bs - branchNumerator bs := by
  induction bs with
  | nil =>
    change ((Matrix.of fun (_ _ : Unit) => -d).charmatrix).det = (X+C d)*1-0
    rw [Matrix.det_unique]
    simp [Matrix.charmatrix_apply_eq]
  | cons b bs ih =>
    change (edgeJoin (assembledMatrix d bs) b.matrix (branchRoot bs) b.root
      b.inward b.outward).charpoly = _
    rw [charpoly_edgeJoin, ih, assembled_cofactor, branchProduct_cons, branchNumerator]
    dsimp only [branchP, branchR, branchF]
    ring

end HydrologyTree

/-! Exact leaf deletion for the characteristic polynomial of a finite real
matrix. Retained principal diagonals include all original boundary-exit rates. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]

abbrev DeletedVertex (l : ι) := {v : ι // v ≠ l}

/-- Explicit reindexing into the retained vertices and the deleted leaf. -/
def deleteVertexEquiv (l : ι) : DeletedVertex l ⊕ Unit ≃ ι where
  toFun := Sum.elim Subtype.val (fun _ => l)
  invFun v := if h : v = l then Sum.inr () else Sum.inl ⟨v,h⟩
  left_inv v := by
    rcases v with v | u
    · simp [Sum.elim, v.property]
    · cases u
      simp [Sum.elim]
  right_inv v := by
    by_cases h : v = l <;> simp [Sum.elim, h]

/-- Literal principal submatrix; its diagonal is not recalculated. -/
def deletedMatrix (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (l : ι) :
    Matrix (DeletedVertex l) (DeletedVertex l) ℝ := A.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val

def singletonMatrix (d : ℝ) : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ := Matrix.of fun _ _ => d

@[simp] lemma singletonMatrix_charpoly (d : ℝ) :
    (singletonMatrix d).charpoly = X-C d := by
  rw [Matrix.charpoly, Matrix.det_unique]
  simp [singletonMatrix, Matrix.charmatrix_apply_eq]

@[simp] lemma singletonMatrix_cofactor (d : ℝ) :
    diagonalCofactor (singletonMatrix d) () = 1 := by
  rw [diagonalCofactor, Matrix.adjugate_subsingleton]
  rfl

lemma charpoly_submatrix_equiv (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (e : κ ≃ ι) :
    (A.submatrix e e).charpoly = A.charpoly := by
  exact Matrix.charpoly_reindex e.symm A

/-- A structurally isolated leaf gives the actual edge-join matrix after
reindexing. The premises describe zero entries only, not any determinant formula. -/
theorem leaf_matrix_decomposition (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (l p : ι) (hp : p ≠ l)
    (hrow : ∀ v, v ≠ l → A l v = if v = p then A l p else 0)
    (hcol : ∀ v, v ≠ l → A v l = if v = p then A p l else 0) :
    A.submatrix (deleteVertexEquiv l) (deleteVertexEquiv l) =
      edgeJoin (deletedMatrix A l) (singletonMatrix (A l l)) ⟨p,hp⟩ () (A p l) (A l p) := by
  ext u v
  rcases u with u | u <;> rcases v with v | v
  · rfl
  · cases v
    simpa [edgeJoin, deleteVertexEquiv, Sum.elim, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.single_apply,
      Subtype.ext_iff, eq_comm] using hcol u.val u.property
  · cases u
    simpa [edgeJoin, deleteVertexEquiv, Sum.elim, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.single_apply,
      Subtype.ext_iff, eq_comm] using hrow v.val v.property
  · cases u
    cases v
    rfl

/-- The exact finite-matrix leaf recurrence, valid at all rates and eigenvalues. -/
theorem charpoly_delete_leaf (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (l p : ι) (hp : p ≠ l)
    (hrow : ∀ v, v ≠ l → A l v = if v = p then A l p else 0)
    (hcol : ∀ v, v ≠ l → A v l = if v = p then A p l else 0) :
    A.charpoly = (X-C (A l l)) * (deletedMatrix A l).charpoly -
      C (A p l * A l p) * diagonalCofactor (deletedMatrix A l) ⟨p,hp⟩ := by
  rw [← charpoly_submatrix_equiv A (deleteVertexEquiv l),
    leaf_matrix_decomposition A l p hp hrow hcol, charpoly_edgeJoin,
    singletonMatrix_charpoly, singletonMatrix_cofactor]
  ring

end HydrologyTree

are proved here, not imported as hypotheses. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def terminalVertex (n : ℕ) : Fin (n+2) := (Fin.last n).succ

lemma parent_ne_terminal {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree (n+1)) (e : Fin (n+1)) :
    t.parent e ≠ terminalVertex n := by
  intro h
  have hp := t.parent_le e
  have he := e.isLt
  have hh := congrArg Fin.val h
  simp [terminalVertex] at hh
  omega

lemma succ_ne_terminal {n : ℕ} (e : Fin (n+1)) (he : e ≠ Fin.last n) :
    e.succ ≠ terminalVertex n := by
  intro h
  exact he (Fin.succ_injective _ h)

/-- The last numbered vertex has only its parent as a possible recipient. -/
theorem compartment_terminal_column {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree (n+1)) (x : TreeRates (n+1))
    (v : Fin (n+2)) (hv : v ≠ terminalVertex n) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v (terminalVertex n) =
      if v = t.parent (Fin.last n) then x.1 (terminalVertex n) else 0 := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x _ _ hv]
  have hparent := parent_ne_terminal t
  simp only [hparent, and_false, ite_false, mul_zero, add_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Fin.last n)]
  · simp [terminalVertex, eq_comm]
  · intro e _ he
    simp [succ_ne_terminal e he]
  · simp

/-- The last numbered vertex can receive water only from its parent. -/
theorem compartment_terminal_row {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree (n+1)) (x : TreeRates (n+1))
    (v : Fin (n+2)) (hv : v ≠ terminalVertex n) :
    compartmentMatrix t x (terminalVertex n) v =
      if v = t.parent (Fin.last n) then x.2 (Fin.last n) else 0 := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x _ _ (Ne.symm hv)]
  have hparent := parent_ne_terminal t
  simp only [hparent, false_and, ite_false, mul_zero, zero_add]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Fin.last n)]
  · simp [terminalVertex, eq_comm]
  · intro e _ he
    simp [succ_ne_terminal e he]
  · simp

lemma compartment_terminal_diagonal {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree (n+1)) (x : TreeRates (n+1)) :
    compartmentMatrix t x (terminalVertex n) (terminalVertex n) = -x.1 (terminalVertex n) := by
  rw [compartment_diagonal]
  change -(x.1 (terminalVertex n) + parentCLM t x.2 (terminalVertex n)) = _
  rw [parentCLM_apply]
  simp [parent_ne_terminal]

def terminalMinor {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree (n+1)) (x : TreeRates (n+1)) :=
  deletedMatrix (compartmentMatrix t x) (terminalVertex n)

/-- Full characteristic recurrence for every physical topologically numbered
tree with at least one edge, at all real rate vectors including zero rates.
The retained matrix is the actual principal minor with original diagonals. -/
theorem physicalCharacteristic_terminal_recursion {n : ℕ}
    (t : OrderedTree (n+1)) (x : TreeRates (n+1)) :
    physicalCharacteristic t x =
      (X + C (x.1 (terminalVertex n))) * (terminalMinor t x).charpoly -
      C (x.1 (terminalVertex n) * x.2 (Fin.last n)) *
        diagonalCofactor (terminalMinor t x)
          ⟨t.parent (Fin.last n), parent_ne_terminal t (Fin.last n)⟩ := by
  have hrow : ∀ v, v ≠ terminalVertex n →
      compartmentMatrix t x (terminalVertex n) v =
        if v = t.parent (Fin.last n) then
          compartmentMatrix t x (terminalVertex n) (t.parent (Fin.last n)) else 0 := by
    intro v hv
    rw [compartment_terminal_row t x v hv]
    simp only [terminalVertex, compartment_outward_entry]
  have hcol : ∀ v, v ≠ terminalVertex n →
      compartmentMatrix t x v (terminalVertex n) =
        if v = t.parent (Fin.last n) then
          compartmentMatrix t x (t.parent (Fin.last n)) (terminalVertex n) else 0 := by
    intro v hv
    rw [compartment_terminal_column t x v hv]
    simp only [terminalVertex, compartment_inward_entry]
  have h := charpoly_delete_leaf (compartmentMatrix t x) (terminalVertex n)
    (t.parent (Fin.last n)) (parent_ne_terminal t (Fin.last n)) hrow hcol
  rw [compartment_terminal_diagonal] at h
  simpa only [physicalCharacteristic, terminalMinor,
    terminalVertex, compartment_inward_entry, compartment_outward_entry,
    map_neg, sub_neg_eq_add] using h

  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext

@[reducible] def ProductInput : List ℕ → Type

  | m :: ms => Coeff m × ProductInput ms

instance productInputNormed : (ms : List ℕ) → NormedAddCommGroup (ProductInput ms)
  | [] => inferInstanceAs (NormedAddCommGroup (Coeff 0))
  | m :: ms => by

  | [] => inferInstanceAs (NormedSpace ℝ (Coeff 0))
  | m :: ms => by
    letI := productInputNormedSpace ms
    exact inferInstanceAs (NormedSpace ℝ (Coeff m × ProductInput ms))

  | [] => degreeLT.basis ℝ 0
  | m :: ms => ((degreeLT.basis ℝ m).prod (familyBasis ms)).reindex finSumFinEquiv

  | [], _ => 0
  | m :: ms, x => monicMultiply (x.1, familyProduct ms x.2)

def familyProductDerivative : (ms : List ℕ) → (x : ProductInput ms) →
    ProductInput ms →L[ℝ] Coeff ms.sum
  | [], _ => 0
  | m :: ms, x =>
    (monoSylv (x.1, familyProduct ms x.2)).comp
      (keepLeft (E₀ := Coeff m) (familyProductDerivative ms x.2))

    HasFDerivAt (familyProduct ms) (familyProductDerivative ms x) x := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => exact hasFDerivAt_const (0 : Coeff 0) x
  | cons m ms ih =>
    have hfst := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Coeff m) (ProductInput ms)).hasFDerivAt (x := x)
    have hsnd := (ih x.2).comp x
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Coeff m) (ProductInput ms)).hasFDerivAt
    exact (hasFDerivAt_monicMultiply (x.1,familyProduct ms x.2)).comp x (hfst.prodMk hsnd)

  | [], _ => []
  | _ :: ms, x => (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X]) :: familyPolynomials ms x.2

theorem familyProduct_reconstruct (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :

  induction ms with
  | nil =>
    change (monicPoly (0 : Coeff 0) : ℝ[X]) = 1
    simp [coe_monicPoly]

    change (monicPoly (monicMultiply (x.1,familyProduct ms x.2)) : ℝ[X]) = _
    rw [monicMultiply_reconstruct, ih]

  | [], _ => 1

  simpa only [monicMultiplyJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_monicMultiply x).fderiv] using
    monicMultiplyJacobian_eq x

theorem det_familyProductDerivative (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (familyBasis ms) (degreeLT.basis ℝ ms.sum)
      (familyProductDerivative ms x).toLinearMap).det = familyResultant ms x := by
  induction ms with
  | nil =>
    change (LinearMap.toMatrix (degreeLT.basis ℝ 0) (degreeLT.basis ℝ 0)
      (0 : Coeff 0 →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff 0)).det = 1
    simp
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change (LinearMap.toMatrix (((degreeLT.basis ℝ m).prod (familyBasis ms)).reindex finSumFinEquiv)
      (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+ms.sum))
      ((monoSylv (x.1,familyProduct ms x.2)).toLinearMap.comp
        (keepLeft (E₀ := Coeff m) (familyProductDerivative ms x.2)).toLinearMap)).det =
      _ * familyResultant ms x.2
    rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_comp
      (((degreeLT.basis ℝ m).prod (familyBasis ms)).reindex finSumFinEquiv) (pairBasis m ms.sum)
      (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+ms.sum)), Matrix.det_mul, det_monoSylv]
    congr 1
    rw [pairBasis, det_both_reindex, det_keepLeft, ih]

/-- The determinant is taken from fderiv of the actual coefficient map. -/
def familyProductJacobian (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (familyBasis ms) (degreeLT.basis ℝ ms.sum)
    (fderiv ℝ (familyProduct ms) x).toLinearMap).det

theorem familyProductJacobian_eq (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    familyProductJacobian ms x = familyResultant ms x := by
  rw [familyProductJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_familyProduct ms x).fderiv,
    det_familyProductDerivative]

import HydrologyTree.FamilyProduct

/-! Exact pairwise resultant expansion of the arbitrary-family product Jacobian. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- One factor for every ordered-by-position pair i<j, repetitions allowed. -/
def pairwiseResultants : List ℝ[X] → ℝ
  | [] => 1
  | p :: ps => (ps.map fun q => p.resultant q).prod * pairwiseResultants ps

lemma familyPolynomials_degree_sum (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    ((familyPolynomials ms x).map Polynomial.natDegree).sum = ms.sum := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons m ms ih => simp only [familyPolynomials, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, natDegree_monicPoly, ih]

lemma familyPolynomials_monic (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    ∀ p ∈ familyPolynomials ms x, p.Monic := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => simp [familyPolynomials]
  | cons m ms ih =>
    intro p hp
    simp only [familyPolynomials, List.mem_cons] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | hp
    · exact monic_monicPoly _
    · exact ih _ p hp

lemma monic_list_prod (ps : List ℝ[X]) (hs : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Monic) : ps.prod.Monic := by
  induction ps with
  | nil => exact Polynomial.monic_one
  | cons p ps ih =>
    exact (hs p (by simp)).mul (ih (fun q hq => hs q (by simp [hq])))

lemma natDegree_monic_list_prod (ps : List ℝ[X]) (hs : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Monic) :
    ps.prod.natDegree = (ps.map Polynomial.natDegree).sum := by
  induction ps with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
    have hp := hs p (by simp)
    have ht : ∀ q ∈ ps, q.Monic := fun q hq => hs q (by simp [hq])
    rw [List.prod_cons, Polynomial.natDegree_mul hp.ne_zero (monic_list_prod ps ht).ne_zero,
      ih ht]
    rfl

lemma resultant_list_prod (p : ℝ[X]) (ps : List ℝ[X]) (hs : ∀ q ∈ ps, q.Monic) :
    p.resultant ps.prod = (ps.map fun q => p.resultant q).prod := by
  induction ps with
  | nil => simp
  | cons q qs ih =>
    have hq := hs q (by simp)
    have ht : ∀ r ∈ qs, r.Monic := fun r hr => hs r (by simp [hr])
    rw [List.prod_cons,
      Polynomial.natDegree_mul hq.ne_zero (monic_list_prod qs ht).ne_zero,
      Polynomial.resultant_mul_right _ _ _ _ le_rfl, ih ht]
    rfl

/-- The recursive derivative determinant is exactly the product over all pairs. -/
theorem familyResultant_eq_pairwise (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    familyResultant ms x = pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials ms x) := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change Polynomial.resultant (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly (familyProduct ms x.2)) m ms.sum *
        familyResultant ms x.2 = _
    rw [ih]
    change _ = ((familyPolynomials ms x.2).map fun q =>
      (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X]).resultant q).prod * pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials ms x.2)
    congr 1
    have h := resultant_list_prod (monicPoly x.1) (familyPolynomials ms x.2)
      (familyPolynomials_monic ms x.2)
    rw [← familyProduct_reconstruct] at h
    simpa only [natDegree_monicPoly] using h

/-- Full all-degree, all-coefficient product-Jacobian formula in pairwise form. -/
theorem familyProductJacobian_eq_pairwise (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    familyProductJacobian ms x = pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials ms x) := by
  rw [familyProductJacobian_eq, familyResultant_eq_pairwise]

end HydrologyTree

import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Comp
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Operations

/-! Smoothness of the actual monic factor product; differentiating its derivative
is justified rather than assumed as a hidden Hessian input. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma contDiff_monicPoly (n : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (monicPoly (n := n)) :=
  contDiff_const.add (liftCLM n).contDiff

lemma contDiff_monicMultiply (m n : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (monicMultiply (m := m) (n := n)) := by
  have ha := (contDiff_monicPoly m).comp
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).contDiff
  have hb := (contDiff_monicPoly n).comp
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).contDiff
  exact ((mulCLM (m+1) (n+1) (m+n)).contDiff.comp ha).clm_apply hb

/-- Every finite factor product has the differentiability needed by the tangent lift. -/
theorem contDiff_familyProduct (ms : List ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (familyProduct ms) := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => exact contDiff_const
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x : Coeff m × ProductInput ms =>
      monicMultiply (x.1, familyProduct ms x.2))
    have ha : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x : Coeff m × ProductInput ms => x.1) :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Coeff m) (ProductInput ms)).contDiff
    have hb : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x : Coeff m × ProductInput ms => familyProduct ms x.2) :=
      ih.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Coeff m) (ProductInput ms)).contDiff
    exact (contDiff_monicMultiply m ms.sum).comp (ha.prodMk hb)

lemma familyProductDerivative_eq_fderiv (ms : List ℕ) :
    familyProductDerivative ms = fderiv ℝ (familyProduct ms) := by
  funext x
  exact (hasFDerivAt_familyProduct ms x).fderiv.symm

/-- The derivative-valued map is itself differentiable everywhere. -/
theorem differentiable_familyProductDerivative (ms : List ℕ) :
    Differentiable ℝ (familyProductDerivative ms) := by
  rw [familyProductDerivative_eq_fderiv]
  exact ((contDiff_familyProduct ms).fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiable_one

end HydrologyTree

import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Comp

/-! The Jacobian of a differentiable tangent lift has two copies of the
original Jacobian. Derivative-valued regularity is an explicit proved input
at each later application, not an unproved family Hessian assertion. -/
open Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

def tangentLift (f : E → F) (L : E → E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × E) : F × F :=
  (f x.1, L x.1 x.2)

def tangentDerivative (L : E → E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × E) :
    (E × E) →L[ℝ] (F × F) :=
  repeatedBlock (L x.1) ((fderiv ℝ L x.1).flip x.2)

/-- Full tangent-lift derivative, including the second-order off-diagonal block. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_tangentLift (f : E → F) (L : E → E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × E)
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f (L x.1) x.1) (hL : DifferentiableAt ℝ L x.1) :
    HasFDerivAt (tangentLift f L) (tangentDerivative L x) x := by
  let P : (E × E) →L[ℝ] E := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E E
  let Q : (E × E) →L[ℝ] E := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E E
  have h1 := hf.comp x P.hasFDerivAt
  have h2 := (hL.hasFDerivAt.comp x P.hasFDerivAt).clm_apply Q.hasFDerivAt
  apply (h1.prodMk h2).congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro z
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · change L x.1 z.2 + (fderiv ℝ L x.1 z.1) x.2 =
      (fderiv ℝ L x.1 z.1) x.2 + L x.1 z.2
    exact add_comm _ _

/-- The determinant is the square without any invertibility assumption. -/
theorem tangentLift_jacobian {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F)
    (f : E → F) (L : E → E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × E)
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f (L x.1) x.1) (hL : DifferentiableAt ℝ L x.1) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bE) (bF.prod bF)
      (fderiv ℝ (tangentLift f L) x).toLinearMap).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF (L x.1).toLinearMap).det ^ 2 := by
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_tangentLift f L x hf hL).fderiv, tangentDerivative,
    det_repeatedBlock]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.FamilyResultants
import HydrologyTree.FamilySmoothness
import HydrologyTree.TangentJacobian

/-! The all-arity polynomial gluing theorem in actual coefficient spaces.
All derivatives, smoothness and polynomial identities are proved; there is no
coprimality, positivity or nonsingularity hypothesis. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Actual numerator sum, one numerator in place of each corresponding factor. -/
def familyNumerator : (ms : List ℕ) → ProductInput ms → ProductInput ms → ℝ[X]
  | [], _, _ => 0
  | _ :: ms, p, r =>
      (r.1 : ℝ[X]) * (monicPoly (familyProduct ms p.2) : ℝ[X]) +
      (monicPoly p.1 : ℝ[X]) * familyNumerator ms p.2 r.2

lemma monoSylv_polynomial {m n : ℕ} (p r : PolyPair m n) :
    (monoSylv p r : ℝ[X]) =
      (monicPoly p.1 : ℝ[X]) * (r.2 : ℝ[X]) +
      (monicPoly p.2 : ℝ[X]) * (r.1 : ℝ[X]) := rfl

/-- The derivative applied to the numerator data is exactly the full numerator
polynomial, not merely a sampled evaluation or a truncated approximation. -/
theorem familyProductDerivative_polynomial (ms : List ℕ)
    (p r : ProductInput ms) :
    (familyProductDerivative ms p r : ℝ[X]) = familyNumerator ms p r := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change (monoSylv (p.1,familyProduct ms p.2)
      (r.1,familyProductDerivative ms p.2 r.2) : ℝ[X]) = _
    rw [monoSylv_polynomial, ih]
    dsimp only [familyNumerator]
    ring

/-- Arbitrarily many monic factors with their arbitrary strict-degree numerators. -/
def familyGlue (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms × ProductInput ms) :
    Coeff ms.sum × Coeff ms.sum :=
  (familyProduct ms x.1, cut ms.sum (familyNumerator ms x.1 x.2))

lemma familyGlue_eq_tangentLift (ms : List ℕ) :
    familyGlue ms = tangentLift (familyProduct ms) (familyProductDerivative ms) := by
  funext x
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · change cut ms.sum (familyNumerator ms x.1 x.2) = familyProductDerivative ms x.1 x.2
    rw [← familyProductDerivative_polynomial, cut_coe]

/-- The full second output encodes the true numerator polynomial. -/
theorem familyGlue_numerator_exact (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms × ProductInput ms) :
    ((familyGlue ms x).2 : ℝ[X]) = familyNumerator ms x.1 x.2 := by
  rw [familyGlue_eq_tangentLift]
  exact familyProductDerivative_polynomial ms x.1 x.2

theorem hasFDerivAt_familyGlue (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms × ProductInput ms) :
    HasFDerivAt (familyGlue ms) (tangentDerivative (familyProductDerivative ms) x) x := by
  rw [familyGlue_eq_tangentLift]
  exact hasFDerivAt_tangentLift _ _ _ (hasFDerivAt_familyProduct ms x.1)
    (differentiable_familyProductDerivative ms x.1)

def familyGlueJacobian (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms × ProductInput ms) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((familyBasis ms).prod (familyBasis ms))
    ((degreeLT.basis ℝ ms.sum).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ ms.sum))
    (fderiv ℝ (familyGlue ms) x).toLinearMap).det

/-- The full gluing Jacobian, for every finite factor family and all coefficients,
is the square of the pairwise resultant product, including every singular case. -/
theorem familyGlueJacobian_eq_pairwise (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms × ProductInput ms) :
    familyGlueJacobian ms x = pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials ms x.1)^2 := by
  rw [familyGlueJacobian, familyGlue_eq_tangentLift,
    tangentLift_jacobian _ _ _ _ _ (hasFDerivAt_familyProduct ms x.1)
      (differentiable_familyProductDerivative ms x.1),
    det_familyProductDerivative, familyResultant_eq_pairwise]

end HydrologyTree

/-! Canonical root-branch partition of the original parent-encoded finite tree.
This is combinatorial data independent of every rate parameter. -/
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- The unique first vertex after root 0 on the parent path of v; root maps to 0. -/
def rootBranchVertex {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) : Fin (n+1) :=
  if hv : v = 0 then 0
  else if parentVertex t v = 0 then v
  else rootBranchVertex t (parentVertex t v)
termination_by v.val
decreasing_by exact parentVertex_lt t v hv

@[simp] lemma rootBranchVertex_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    rootBranchVertex t 0 = 0 := by rw [rootBranchVertex]; simp

lemma rootBranchVertex_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1))
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hp : parentVertex t v = 0) : rootBranchVertex t v = v := by
  rw [rootBranchVertex]
  simp [hv,hp]

lemma rootBranchVertex_step {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1))
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hp : parentVertex t v ≠ 0) :
    rootBranchVertex t v = rootBranchVertex t (parentVertex t v) := by
  rw [rootBranchVertex]
  simp [hv,hp]

/-- A nonroot vertex belongs to a nonroot branch. -/
theorem rootBranchVertex_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    rootBranchVertex t v ≠ 0 := by
  induction v using (measure Fin.val).wf.induction with
  | h v ih =>
    by_cases hp : parentVertex t v = 0
    · rwa [rootBranchVertex_child t v hv hp]
    · rw [rootBranchVertex_step t v hv hp]
      exact ih (parentVertex t v) (parentVertex_lt t v hv) hp

/-- The branch representative is always a direct child of the root. -/
theorem rootBranchVertex_parent_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    parentVertex t (rootBranchVertex t v) = 0 := by
  induction v using (measure Fin.val).wf.induction with
  | h v ih =>
    by_cases hp : parentVertex t v = 0
    · rwa [rootBranchVertex_child t v hv hp]
    · rw [rootBranchVertex_step t v hv hp]
      exact ih (parentVertex t v) (parentVertex_lt t v hv) hp

abbrev RootChild {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :=
  {v : Fin (n+1) // v ≠ 0 ∧ parentVertex t v = 0}

abbrev BranchVertex {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) :=
  {v : Fin (n+1) // rootBranchVertex t v = c.val}

lemma branchVertex_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (v : BranchVertex t c) :
    v.val ≠ 0 := by
  intro hv
  have hh := v.property
  rw [hv, rootBranchVertex_zero] at hh
  exact c.property.1 hh.symm

def branchRootVertex {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) : BranchVertex t c :=
  ⟨c.val, rootBranchVertex_child t c.val c.property.1 c.property.2⟩

def rootPartitionMap {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Unit ⊕ (Σ c : RootChild t, BranchVertex t c) → Fin (n+1)
  | .inl _ => 0
  | .inr v => v.2.val

lemma rootPartitionMap_injective {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Function.Injective (rootPartitionMap t) := by
  intro u v h
  rcases u with u | ⟨c,u⟩ <;> rcases v with v | ⟨d,v⟩
  · cases u; cases v; rfl
  · exact False.elim (branchVertex_ne_zero t d v h.symm)
  · exact False.elim (branchVertex_ne_zero t c u h)
  · have hc : c = d := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact u.property.symm.trans ((congrArg (rootBranchVertex t) h).trans v.property)
    subst d
    have huv : u = v := Subtype.ext h
    subst v
    rfl

lemma rootPartitionMap_surjective {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Function.Surjective (rootPartitionMap t) := by
  intro v
  by_cases hv : v = 0
  · exact ⟨.inl (), hv.symm⟩
  · let c : RootChild t := ⟨rootBranchVertex t v,
      rootBranchVertex_ne_zero t v hv, rootBranchVertex_parent_zero t v hv⟩
    exact ⟨.inr ⟨c,⟨v,rfl⟩⟩,rfl⟩

/-- Exact rate-independent reindexing of all vertices into root and child branches. -/
def rootPartitionEquiv {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Unit ⊕ (Σ c : RootChild t, BranchVertex t c) ≃ Fin (n+1) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (rootPartitionMap t) ⟨rootPartitionMap_injective t,rootPartitionMap_surjective t⟩

@[simp] lemma rootPartitionEquiv_root {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    rootPartitionEquiv t (.inl ()) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma rootPartitionEquiv_branch {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (c : RootChild t) (v : BranchVertex t c) :
    rootPartitionEquiv t (.inr ⟨c,v⟩) = v.val := rfl

end HydrologyTree

/-! Exact sparsity of the physical tree matrix under its proved root-branch
partition. No partition of the matrix is assumed as a proof input. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma rootBranch_edge_step {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (e : Fin n)
    (hp : t.parent e ≠ 0) :
    rootBranchVertex t e.succ = rootBranchVertex t (t.parent e) := by
  exact rootBranchVertex_step t e.succ (Fin.succ_ne_zero e) hp

/-- Distinct nonroot branches have no direct physical transfer in either direction. -/
theorem compartment_cross_branch_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (v w : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0)
    (hb : rootBranchVertex t v ≠ rootBranchVertex t w) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v w = 0 := by
  have hvw : v ≠ w := fun h => hb (congrArg (rootBranchVertex t) h)
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x v w hvw]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro e _
  have h1 : ¬(t.parent e = v ∧ e.succ = w) := by
    rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
    have hp : t.parent e ≠ 0 := by rwa [h1]
    have hh := rootBranch_edge_step t e hp
    rw [h1,h2] at hh
    exact hb hh.symm
  have h2 : ¬(e.succ = v ∧ t.parent e = w) := by
    rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
    have hp : t.parent e ≠ 0 := by rwa [h2]
    have hh := rootBranch_edge_step t e hp
    rw [h1,h2] at hh
    exact hb hh
  simp [h1,h2]

/-- Actual principal branch block, retaining the outgoing-to-root diagonal. -/
def physicalBranchMatrix {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (c : RootChild t) :
    Matrix (BranchVertex t c) (BranchVertex t c) ℝ :=
  (compartmentMatrix t x).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val

/-- The reindexed physical matrix has the exact actual branch on each diagonal block. -/
theorem rootPartition_same_block {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (c : RootChild t) (v w : BranchVertex t c) :
    ((compartmentMatrix t x).submatrix (rootPartitionEquiv t) (rootPartitionEquiv t))
      (.inr ⟨c,v⟩) (.inr ⟨c,w⟩) = physicalBranchMatrix t x c v w := rfl

/-- Every cross-block entry of the actual reindexed matrix vanishes. -/
theorem rootPartition_different_blocks {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (c d : RootChild t) (hcd : c ≠ d) (v : BranchVertex t c) (w : BranchVertex t d) :
    ((compartmentMatrix t x).submatrix (rootPartitionEquiv t) (rootPartitionEquiv t))
      (.inr ⟨c,v⟩) (.inr ⟨d,w⟩) = 0 := by
  apply compartment_cross_branch_zero t x v.val w.val
    (branchVertex_ne_zero t c v) (branchVertex_ne_zero t d w)
  intro h
  apply hcd
  exact Subtype.ext (v.property.symm.trans (h.trans w.property))

lemma parentVertex_succ {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (e : Fin n) :
    parentVertex t e.succ = t.parent e := rfl

/-- A nondirect descendant has no inward transfer to the root. -/
theorem compartment_root_column_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hp : parentVertex t v ≠ 0) :
    compartmentMatrix t x 0 v = 0 := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x 0 v (Ne.symm hv)]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro e _
  have h1 : ¬(t.parent e = 0 ∧ e.succ = v) := by
    rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
    apply hp
    rw [← h2, parentVertex_succ, h1]
  simp [h1, Fin.succ_ne_zero]

/-- A nondirect descendant receives no outward transfer directly from the root. -/
theorem compartment_root_row_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hp : parentVertex t v ≠ 0) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v 0 = 0 := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x v 0 hv]

    · subst v; simp
    · by_cases hp : parentVertex t v = 0

    Fintype.card (BranchVertex t c) = childEdgeCount t c + 1 := by
  unfold childEdgeCount

  omega

    rw [← hj]

  · exact branchRoot_min t c _

      apply (childEnumeration t c).lt_iff_lt.mp

  have hnon : Fintype.card {v : Fin (n+1) // v ≠ 0} = n := by
    simp

  have hd : (Matrix.blockDiagonal' B).det ≠ 0 := by

  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro c _
    rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun j => (B j).det) (Finset.mem_univ c),
      Matrix.inv_def]
    simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]

/-! Actual characteristic/cofactor formulas for a root and arbitrary heterogeneous
child blocks. All exceptional spectral points are covered by polynomial identities. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {C : Type*} [Fintype C] [LinearOrder C] {V : C → Type*}
  [∀ c, Fintype (V c)] [∀ c, DecidableEq (V c)]

lemma scalar_sub_arrow (d s : ℝ) (B : ∀ c, Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ)
    (r : ∀ c, V c) (a f : C → ℝ) :
    Matrix.scalar (Unit ⊕ (Σ c, V c)) s - arrowMatrix d B r a f =
      arrowMatrix (s-d) (fun c => Matrix.scalar (V c) s - B c) r (-a) (-f) := by
  ext i j
  rcases i with i | ⟨c,i⟩ <;> rcases j with j | ⟨e,j⟩
  · cases i; cases j; simp [arrowMatrix, Matrix.scalar_apply]
  · cases i; simp [arrowMatrix, arrowRow, Matrix.scalar_apply, neg_ite]
  · cases j; simp [arrowMatrix, arrowColumn, Matrix.scalar_apply, neg_ite]
  · have h := congrArg (fun M => M ⟨c,i⟩ ⟨e,j⟩) (scalar_sub_dependent_blocks B s)
    simpa only [arrowMatrix, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂, Matrix.sub_apply,
      Matrix.scalar_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Sum.inr.injEq] using h

/-- Full root characteristic recurrence for an arbitrary finite family, without
nonzero-rate, simple-spectrum, or coprimality assumptions. -/
theorem charpoly_arrowMatrix (d : ℝ) (B : ∀ c, Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ)
    (r : ∀ c, V c) (a f : C → ℝ) :
    (arrowMatrix d B r a f).charpoly = (X - Polynomial.C d) * (∏ c, (B c).charpoly) -
      ∑ c, Polynomial.C (a c * f c) * diagonalCofactor (B c) (r c) *
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, (B j).charpoly := by
  have hp : (∏ c, (B c).charpoly).Monic :=
    Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun c _ => Matrix.charpoly_monic _)
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
  apply (infinite_nonroots _ hp.ne_zero).mono
  intro s hs
  have hB : ∀ c, (Matrix.scalar (V c) s - B c).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro c
    have hn : (∏ c, ((B c).charpoly).eval s) ≠ 0 := by simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Polynomial.eval_prod] using hs
    rw [← Matrix.eval_charpoly]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mp hn c (Finset.mem_univ c)
  have h := det_arrowMatrix_cofactors (s-d)
    (fun c => Matrix.scalar (V c) s - B c) r (-a) (-f) hB
  simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Matrix.eval_charpoly, scalar_sub_arrow,
    Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_prod,
    Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C,
    eval_diagonalCofactor, Pi.neg_apply, neg_mul_neg] using h

lemma adjugate_root_block {K W : Type*} [CommRing K] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (A : Matrix Unit Unit K) (B : Matrix Unit W K) (C : Matrix W Unit K) (D : Matrix W W K) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A B C D).adjugate (.inl ()) (.inl ()) = D.det := by
  rw [Matrix.adjugate_apply]
  have hm : (Matrix.fromBlocks A B C D).updateRow (.inl ()) (Pi.single (.inl ()) 1) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks 1 0 C D := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [Pi.single_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
  rw [hm, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂, Matrix.det_one, one_mul]

/-- The actual root cofactor is the product of the actual child characteristic polynomials. -/
theorem cofactor_arrowMatrix (d : ℝ) (B : ∀ c, Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ)
    (r : ∀ c, V c) (a f : C → ℝ) :
    diagonalCofactor (arrowMatrix d B r a f) (.inl ()) = ∏ c, (B c).charpoly := by
  rw [diagonalCofactor, arrowMatrix, Matrix.charmatrix_fromBlocks, adjugate_root_block]
  exact charpoly_dependent_blocks B

end HydrologyTree

/-! End-to-end root recursions for the original physical tree's characteristic
polynomial and root cofactor, in terms of the proved smaller physical child trees. -/
open Matrix Polynomial

namespace HydrologyTree

lemma root_outward_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (x : TreeRates n) :
    compartmentMatrix t x c.val 0 = outwardByVertex x.2 c.val := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_parent_formula t x c.val 0 c.property.1]
  simp only [ite_eq_right c.property.1, c.property.2, ite_true, zero_add]

lemma physicalRootBlock_eq_arrow {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    physicalRootBlockMatrix t x = arrowMatrix (-(rateChart t x).1 0)
      (physicalBranchMatrix t x) (branchRootVertex t) (fun c => x.1 c.val)
      (fun c => outwardByVertex x.2 c.val) := by
  unfold physicalRootBlockMatrix arrowMatrix
  congr 1
  · ext u ⟨c,v⟩
    cases u
    simp [rootInwardRow, arrowRow, root_inward_child, branchRootVertex, Subtype.ext_iff]
  · ext ⟨c,v⟩ u
    cases u
    simp [rootOutwardColumn, arrowColumn, root_outward_child, branchRootVertex, Subtype.ext_iff]

lemma diagonalCofactor_reindex {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (e : κ ≃ ι) (i : κ) :
    diagonalCofactor (A.submatrix e e) i = diagonalCofactor A (e i) := by
  change diagonalCofactor (A.reindex e.symm e.symm) i = _
  rw [diagonalCofactor, Matrix.charmatrix_reindex, Matrix.adjugate_reindex]
  rfl

lemma diagonalCofactor_zero {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ) :
    diagonalCofactor A 0 = (A.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ).charpoly := by
  unfold diagonalCofactor
  rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_succ_eq_det_submatrix]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, add_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, Fin.succAbove_zero]
  congr 1
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j; simp [Matrix.charmatrix_apply_eq]
  · simp [Matrix.charmatrix_apply_ne, h]

/-- Actual child characteristic polynomial, in the rate-preserving smaller tree. -/
def childCharacteristic {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (c : RootChild t) : ℝ[X] :=
  physicalCharacteristic (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)

def childCofactor {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (c : RootChild t) : ℝ[X] :=
  physicalRootCofactor (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)

/-- Root cofactor of the original matrix equals the product of all actual child denominators. -/
theorem physicalRootCofactor_child_product {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    physicalRootCofactor t x = ∏ c : RootChild t, childCharacteristic t x c := by
  have h := congrArg (fun M => diagonalCofactor M (.inl ())) (physical_root_block_decomposition t x)
  rw [diagonalCofactor_reindex, rootPartitionEquiv_root, diagonalCofactor_zero,
    physicalRootBlock_eq_arrow] at h
  apply h.trans
  apply (cofactor_arrowMatrix (-(rateChart t x).1 0) (physicalBranchMatrix t x)
    (branchRootVertex t) (fun c => x.1 c.val) (fun c => outwardByVertex x.2 c.val)).trans
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro c _
  exact physicalBranch_charpoly_eq t c x

/-- The complete actual physical root characteristic recursion. It holds for
every tree size and every real rate vector, not merely off the singular set. -/
theorem physicalCharacteristic_child_recursion {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    physicalCharacteristic t x =
      (X + Polynomial.C ((rateChart t x).1 0)) * (∏ c : RootChild t, childCharacteristic t x c) -
      ∑ c : RootChild t, Polynomial.C (x.1 c.val * outwardByVertex x.2 c.val) * childCofactor t x c *
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, childCharacteristic t x j := by
  have h := congrArg Matrix.charpoly (physical_root_block_decomposition t x)
  have he := Matrix.charpoly_reindex (rootPartitionEquiv t).symm (compartmentMatrix t x)
  have ht := he.symm.trans h
  rw [physicalRootBlock_eq_arrow] at ht
  have hrec := charpoly_arrowMatrix (-(rateChart t x).1 0) (physicalBranchMatrix t x)
    (branchRootVertex t) (fun c => x.1 c.val) (fun c => outwardByVertex x.2 c.val)
  have hh := ht.trans hrec
  simp only [map_neg, sub_neg_eq_add, physicalBranch_charpoly_eq,
    physicalBranch_cofactor_eq, childCharacteristic, childCofactor, physicalCharacteristic] at hh ⊢
  convert hh using 1
  congr 3

end HydrologyTree

/-! Exact cancellation criterion for an arbitrary finite branch family.
This is field algebra, including repeated zeros and the empty family. -/
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {K C : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C]

def branchValueNumerator (p b : C → K) : K :=
  ∑ c, b c * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, p j

/-- At a zero of one denominator, every other summand vanishes exactly. -/
lemma branchValueNumerator_at_zero (p b : C → K) (c : C) (hc : p c = 0) :
    branchValueNumerator p b = b c * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, p j := by
  unfold branchValueNumerator
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single c]
  · intro j _ hj
    have hz : (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, p i) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mpr
      exact ⟨c, by simp [Ne.symm hj], hc⟩
    rw [hz, mul_zero]
  · simp

/-- A local common zero is exactly either a child common zero or a collision
between two distinct child denominators, provided the connector coefficients are nonzero. -/
theorem finite_branch_cancellation_iff (d : K) (p f a : C → K) (ha : ∀ c, a c ≠ 0) :
    ((∏ c, p c) = 0 ∧ d * (∏ c, p c) - branchValueNumerator p (fun c => a c * f c) = 0) ↔
      ∃ c, p c = 0 ∧ (f c = 0 ∨ ∃ j, j ≠ c ∧ p j = 0) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp,hN⟩
    obtain ⟨c,_,hc⟩ := Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mp hp
    refine ⟨c,hc,?_⟩
    rw [hp, mul_zero, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero, branchValueNumerator_at_zero p _ c hc] at hN
    have hz : f c = 0 ∨ (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, p j) = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hN with h | h
      · exact Or.inl ((mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (ha c))
      · exact Or.inr h
    rcases hz with hf | hz
    · exact Or.inl hf
    · obtain ⟨j,hj,hp⟩ := Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mp hz
      exact Or.inr ⟨j, (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1, hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨c,hc,h⟩
    have hp : (∏ c, p c) = 0 := Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨c,Finset.mem_univ c,hc⟩
    refine ⟨hp,?_⟩
    rw [hp, mul_zero, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero, branchValueNumerator_at_zero p _ c hc]
    rcases h with hf | ⟨j,hjc,hj⟩
    · rw [hf, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    · have he : (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, p i) = 0 :=
        Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨j, by simp [hjc], hj⟩
      rw [he, mul_zero]

end HydrologyTree

root cofactor: exact local cancellation classification from physical rates. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Only internal directed rates must be nonzero; the original root leak is unrestricted. -/
def NonzeroTreeEdges {n : ℕ} (x : TreeRates n) : Prop :=
  (∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ e : Fin n, x.2 e ≠ 0)

lemma inward_nonroot_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (x : TreeRates n) (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) : x.1 v ≠ 0 := by
  rw [← Fin.succ_pred v hv]
  exact hx.1 _

lemma outward_nonroot_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (x : TreeRates n) (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) : outwardByVertex x.2 v ≠ 0 := by
  rw [← Fin.succ_pred v hv, outwardByVertex_succ]
  exact hx.2 _

/-- Nonzero physical edge rates pass to every genuinely extracted child model. -/
theorem nonzero_child_edges {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t)
    (x : TreeRates n) (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) : NonzeroTreeEdges (childRates t c x) := by
  constructor
  · intro e
    exact inward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx _ (branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c e.succ))
  · intro e
    exact outward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx _ (branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c e.succ))

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra ℝ K]

/-- An actual common zero, with no cancellation of the stored polynomials. -/
def PhysicalCommonRoot {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (z : K) : Prop :=
  aeval z (physicalRootCofactor t x) = 0 ∧ aeval z (physicalCharacteristic t x) = 0

def SiblingCollisionAtRoot {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (z : K) : Prop :=
  ∃ c d : RootChild t, c ≠ d ∧
    aeval z (childCharacteristic t x c) = 0 ∧ aeval z (childCharacteristic t x d) = 0

/-- Exact common-root recursion, including simultaneous cancellations in several children. -/
theorem physicalCommonRoot_local_iff {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) (z : K) :
    PhysicalCommonRoot t x z ↔ SiblingCollisionAtRoot t x z ∨
      ∃ c : RootChild t, PhysicalCommonRoot (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) z := by
  classical
  let p : RootChild t → K := fun c => aeval z (childCharacteristic t x c)
  let f : RootChild t → K := fun c => aeval z (childCofactor t x c)
  let a : RootChild t → K := fun c => algebraMap ℝ K (x.1 c.val * outwardByVertex x.2 c.val)
  have ha : ∀ c, a c ≠ 0 := by
    intro c
    exact (map_ne_zero (algebraMap ℝ K)).mpr (mul_ne_zero (inward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx _ c.property.1)
      (outward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx _ c.property.1))
  have h := finite_branch_cancellation_iff (z + algebraMap ℝ K ((rateChart t x).1 0)) p f a ha
  have he : PhysicalCommonRoot t x z ↔
      ∃ c, p c = 0 ∧ (f c = 0 ∨ ∃ j, j ≠ c ∧ p j = 0) := by
    rw [PhysicalCommonRoot, physicalRootCofactor_child_product,
      physicalCharacteristic_child_recursion]
    simpa only [map_prod, map_sub, map_mul, map_sum, map_add, aeval_X, aeval_C,
      mul_one,
      p, f, a, branchValueNumerator] using h
  rw [he]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c,hp,hc⟩
    rcases hc with hf | ⟨j,hjc,hj⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨c,hf,hp⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨c,j,Ne.symm hjc,hp,hj⟩
  · rintro (⟨c,d,hcd,hc,hd⟩ | ⟨c,hf,hp⟩)
    · exact ⟨c,hc,Or.inr ⟨d,Ne.symm hcd,hd⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨c,hp,Or.inl hf⟩

end HydrologyTree

/-! Complete all-size common-root classification for the original physical
characteristic/cofactor polynomials. Spectral collisions are located at actual
sibling principal blocks, not arbitrary recursively postulated polynomials. -/
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra ℝ K]

/-- A spectral collision between two distinct sibling blocks at some vertex.
All descendants are the actual rate-preserving principal child models. -/
def SiblingCollisionSomewhere {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (z : K) : Prop :=
  SiblingCollisionAtRoot t x z ∨
    ∃ c : RootChild t, SiblingCollisionSomewhere (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) z
termination_by n
decreasing_by exact childEdgeCount_lt t c

/-- Complete classification of common zeros of the actual root cofactor and
characteristic polynomial, for every finite tree and every field extension.
Internal rates need only be nonzero; positivity and root-leak nonzero are unnecessary. -/
theorem physicalCommonRoot_iff_siblingCollision {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) (z : K) :
    PhysicalCommonRoot t x z ↔ SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [physicalCommonRoot_local_iff t x hx, SiblingCollisionSomewhere]
    apply or_congr Iff.rfl
    apply exists_congr
    intro c
    exact ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c)
      (childRates t c x) (nonzero_child_edges t c x hx)

/-- Absence of every sibling collision rules out all cancellations at that value. -/
theorem no_common_root_of_no_sibling_collision {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) (z : K) (hz : ¬SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z) :
    ¬PhysicalCommonRoot t x z := by
  exact mt (physicalCommonRoot_iff_siblingCollision t x hx z).mp hz

/-- Every detected sibling collision actually cancels the original root response:
both original, unreduced polynomials vanish. -/
theorem sibling_collision_gives_common_root {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) (z : K) (hz : SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z) :
    Polynomial.aeval z (physicalRootCofactor t x) = 0 ∧
      Polynomial.aeval z (physicalCharacteristic t x) = 0 := by
  exact (physicalCommonRoot_iff_siblingCollision t x hx z).mpr hz

end HydrologyTree
